translations.literal: Bo Ling, son of Xue Andu, seized four commanderies in Yong; Inspector Prince Xiuofan of Baling attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Ling, son of Xue Andu, seized four commanderies in Yong; Prince Xiuofan of Baling, as inspector, attacked and killed him.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，詔曰：「古者衡虞置制，蝝蚳不收；

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingyou day, an edict said: "In antiquity Heng and Yu established regulations, and the larva of the praying mantis was not collected;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dingyou day an edict declared: "In antiquity, the forest officers Heng and Yu set down regulations by which even the larva of the mantis was left untouched;

sentences.zh: 川澤產育，登器進御。

translations.literal: What rivers and marshes produced was placed in vessels and presented to the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: What rivers and marshes yielded in season was placed on vessels and sent up to the court.

sentences.zh: 所以繁阜民財，養遂生德。

translations.literal: Thus the people's wealth was multiplied and abundance was nourished to complete the virtue of sustaining life.
translations.idiomatic: This was how the people's wealth was made to flourish and the virtue of nurturing life was fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 頃商販逐末，競早爭新，折未實之菓，收豪家之利，籠非膳之翼，為戲童之資。

translations.literal: Recently merchants pursued the secondary, competing for early harvests and novelty; they plucked unripe fruit, gathered profit for great houses, caged wings not fit for the table, and made resources for child entertainers.
translations.idiomatic: Lately merchants have chased profit over substance, vying for the earliest pickings and the newest luxuries—plucking fruit before it ripens, reaping gains for great households, caging birds unfit for the imperial table, and turning living things into toys for child performers.

sentences.zh: 豈所以還風尚本，捐華務實。

translations.literal: How is this the way to restore the wind of revering the root, and to discard adornment and pursue substance?
translations.idiomatic: How can this restore respect for fundamentals, cast off ornament, and pursue what is real?

sentences.zh: 宜修道布仁，以革斯蠹。

translations.literal: It is fitting to cultivate the Way and spread benevolence to reform this corruption.
translations.idiomatic: We must cultivate the Way and spread benevolence to root out this corruption.

sentences.zh: 自今鱗介羽毛，肴核眾品，非時月可採，器味所須，可一皆禁斷，嚴為科制。

translations.literal: From now on, scaled creatures, shellfish, feathers, and all sorts of fruits and delicacies that are not harvestable in their proper months and seasons, and all flavors required for vessels and taste—all may be entirely forbidden and cut off; let strict statutes be established.
translations.idiomatic: From this day forward, fish, shellfish, feathered creatures, fruits, and every delicacy not proper to the season, along with all flavors demanded for the table, are entirely forbidden; strict regulations shall govern this.

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，以中領軍沈攸之行南兗州刺史，率眾北討。

translations.literal: " On renyin, General of the Garrison Shen Youzhi was made Acting Inspector of Southern Yan and led the army north to attack.
translations.idiomatic: " On the renyin day General of the Garrison Shen Youzhi was appointed Acting Inspector of Southern Yan and marched north at the head of the army.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔曰：「法網之用，期世而行，寬惠之道，因時而布。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict said: "The application of the legal net is expected to operate through the ages; the way of lenience and grace is deployed according to the times.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day an edict declared: "The law's net is meant to hold through the ages, but mercy and grace must be meted according to the times.

sentences.zh: 況朕尚德戡亂，依仁馭俗，宜每就弘簡，以隆至治。

translations.literal: Moreover I esteem virtue in quelling disorder and rely on benevolence in governing custom—it is fitting always to approach magnanimity and simplicity to elevate the utmost governance.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, as I hold to virtue in quelling disorder and govern the people through benevolence, I ought always to favor magnanimity and simplicity, so that the highest form of rule may flourish.

sentences.zh: 而頻罹兵革，繇賦未休，軍民巧偽，興事甚多，蹈刑入憲，諒非一科。

translations.literal: Yet we have repeatedly suffered from warfare; corvée and levies have not ceased; soldiers and civilians have grown cunning and false, and litigations are many; those who tread into punishment and enter the statutes—assuredly this is not one category alone.
translations.idiomatic: Yet repeated warfare has not ended corvée and levies; soldiers and civilians alike have grown cunning, lawsuits multiply, and those who fall under the statutes belong to more than one class of offense.

sentences.zh: 至乃假名戎伍，竊爵私庭，因戰散亡，託懼逃役。

translations.literal: Gone so far as to borrow names in the army ranks, steal titles in private halls, exploit scattered flight in war, and pretend fear to escape service.
translations.idiomatic: Some have falsely enrolled in the ranks, usurped titles in private, exploited the chaos of battle to vanish, or feigned terror to evade service.

sentences.zh: 且往諸淪逼，雖經累宥，逋竄之黨，猶為實繁。

translations.literal: Moreover those who in the past were coerced into submission, though repeatedly granted amnesties—the party of fugitives who have fled—are still truly numerous.
translations.idiomatic: And those who were coerced into rebellion in the past, though repeatedly pardoned, still include a great many who remain in flight.

sentences.zh: 宵言永懷，良兼矜疚。

translations.literal: Night words long cherished—truly I feel compassion mixed with guilt.
translations.idiomatic: My thoughts keep me awake at night, and my heart is full of compassion and guilt.

sentences.zh: 思所以重播至澤，覃被區宇。

translations.literal: I think how to again spread the utmost grace and extend it across the realm.
translations.idiomatic: I seek to spread grace once more until it reaches every corner of the realm.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Let a general amnesty be proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 」加新除左光祿大夫王玄謨車騎將軍。

translations.literal: " Newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace Wang Xuanmo was given the additional rank General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: " Newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace Wang Xuanmo was also made General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣吏部尚書褚淵慰勞緣淮將帥，隨宜量賜。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was dispatched to console and encourage the generals and commanders along the Huai, granting rewards in appropriate measure.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was sent to console the generals along the Huai and reward them as circumstances warranted.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以新除右衞將軍劉勔為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On wushen, newly appointed General of the Right Guard Liu Yan was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day newly appointed General of the Right Guard Liu Yan was appointed Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，鎮西將軍、雍州刺史巴陵王休若進號衞將軍，平西將軍、郢州刺史蔡興宗進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guichou day, General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Yong Prince Xiuofan of Baling was advanced in rank to General of the Guard; General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was advanced in rank to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guichou day General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Yong Prince Xiuofan of Baling was promoted to General of the Guard, and General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以越騎校尉周寧民為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao, Colonel of Fast Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day Colonel of Fast Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以皇后六宮以下雜衣千領，金釵千枚，班賜北征將士。

translations.literal: On wuwu, one thousand assorted garments from the empress and the six palaces and below, and one thousand gold hairpins, were distributed and bestowed upon the northern campaign soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day one thousand assorted garments from the empress and the inner palaces and one thousand gold hairpins were distributed among the soldiers on the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚申，前將軍兼冀州刺史崔道固進號平北將軍。

translations.literal: On gengshen, General of the Van concurrently Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was advanced in rank to General Who Levels the North.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day General of the Van and Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was promoted to General Who Levels the North.

sentences.zh: 甲子，曲赦徐、兗、青、冀四州。

translations.literal: On jiazi, a partial amnesty was granted to Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day a partial amnesty was extended to Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，改封新安王延年為始平王。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renwu day, Prince Yannian of Xin'an was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the renwu day Prince Yannian of Xin'an was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.

sentences.zh: 戊子，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the state of Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day the state of Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復郡縣公田。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the public fields of commanderies and counties were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day the commandery and county public fields were restored.

sentences.zh: 鎮西大將軍、西秦河二州刺史吐谷渾拾寅進號征西大將軍。

translations.literal: General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Western Qin and He Tuyuhun Shibin was advanced in rank to General Who Campaigns West.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Western Qin and He Tuyuhun Shibin was promoted to General Who Campaigns West.

sentences.zh: 十一月，立建安王休仁第二子伯猷為江夏王，改封義陽王昶為晉熙王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month—Boyou, second son of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, was established as Prince of Jiangxia; Prince Chang of Yiyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Boyou, second son of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia, and Prince Chang of Yiyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，分徐州置東徐州，以輔國將軍張讜為刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao, Xu was divided to establish Eastern Xu; General Who Assists the State Zhang Dan was made its inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day Eastern Xu was established from Xu Province, and General Who Assists the State Zhang Dan was appointed its inspector.

sentences.zh: 高麗國、百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The states of Goguryeo and Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo and Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，以寧朔將軍劉休賓為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengchen day, General Who Pacifies the North Liu Xiubin was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengchen day General Who Pacifies the North Liu Xiubin was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己未，車駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, jiwei day—the imperial carriage in person sacrificed at the Southern Suburb, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the jiwei day of the first month of spring, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚午，衞將軍巴陵王休若降號左將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, General of the Guard Prince Xiuofan of Baling had his rank reduced to General of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day General of the Guard Prince Xiuofan of Baling was demoted to General of the Left.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，零陵王司馬勗薨。

translations.literal: On yihai, Sima Xu, Prince of Lingling, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Prince of Lingling Sima Xu died.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，以前龍驤將軍常珍奇為平北將軍、司州刺史，珍奇子超越為北冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, xinchou day, former General of the Flying Dragons Chang Zhenqi was made General Who Levels the North and Inspector of Si; Zhenqi's son Chaoyue was made Inspector of Northern Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinchou day former General of the Flying Dragons Chang Zhenqi was appointed General Who Levels the North and Inspector of Si, and his son Chaoyue was made Inspector of Northern Ji.

sentences.zh: [15]乙巳，右光祿大夫、車騎將軍、護軍將軍王玄謨薨。

translations.literal: [15] On yisi, Right Grand Master of the Palace, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuanmo died.
translations.idiomatic: [15] On the yisi day Right Grand Master of the Palace, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuanmo died.

translations.literal: [16] (Editorial note.)
translations.idiomatic: [16] (End of note.)

sentences.zh: 三月己未，[17]以游擊將軍劉懷珍為東徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Third month, jiwei day, [17] General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Liu Huaizhen was made Inspector of Eastern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiwei day, [17] General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Liu Huaizhen was appointed Inspector of Eastern Xu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以軍司馬劉靈遺為梁、南秦二州刺史，[18]南譙太守孫奉伯為交州刺史，[19]交州人李長仁據州叛。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Army Chief Clerk Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin; [18] Administrator of Nanqiao Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiao; [19] the Jiao native Li Changren seized the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Army Chief Clerk Liu Lingyi was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin; [18] Administrator of Nanqiao Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiao; [19] and Li Changren of Jiao seized the province in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 妖賊攻廣州，殺刺史羊希，[20]龍驤將軍陳伯紹討平之。

translations.literal: Demon bandits attacked Guang, killed Inspector Yang Xi, [20] and General of the Flying Dragons Chen Boshao attacked and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel bandits attacked Guang, killed Inspector Yang Xi, [20] and General of the Flying Dragons Chen Boshao suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，復減郡縣田祿之半。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jimao day—the field stipends of commanderies and counties were again reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jimao day the field stipends of commanderies and counties were again cut in half.

sentences.zh: [21]丙申，東海王褘改封廬江王，[22]山陽王休祐改封晉平王，改晉安郡為晉平郡。

translations.literal: [21] On bingshen, Prince Hui of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang; [22] Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinping, and Jin'an commandery was changed to Jinping commandery.
translations.idiomatic: [21] On the bingshen day Prince Hui of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang; [22] Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinping, and Jin'an commandery was renamed Jinping commandery.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，芮芮國及河南王並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the state of Rouran and the King of Henan both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Rouran and the King of Henan both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以豫章太守張辯為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Administrator of Yuzhang Zhang Bian was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Administrator of Yuzhang Zhang Bian was appointed Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，[23]曲赦廣州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yisi day, [23] a partial amnesty was granted to Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yisi day, [23] a partial amnesty was extended to Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以行雍州刺史巴陵王休若行湘州刺史，會稽太守張永為雍州刺史，湘州刺史劉韞為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai, Acting Inspector of Yong Prince Xiuofan of Baling was made Acting Inspector of Xiang; Administrator of Kuaiji Zhang Yong was made Inspector of Yong; Inspector of Xiang Liu Yun was made Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Acting Inspector of Yong Prince Xiuofan of Baling was appointed Acting Inspector of Xiang, Administrator of Kuaiji Zhang Yong was made Inspector of Yong, and Inspector of Xiang Liu Yun was appointed Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，以南康相劉勃為交州刺史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuzi day, Chancellor of Nankang Liu Bo was made Inspector of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuzi day Chancellor of Nankang Liu Bo was appointed Inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: [24]辛卯，分青州置東青州，以輔國將軍沈文靖為東青州刺史。

translations.literal: [24] On xinmao, Qing was divided to establish Eastern Qing; General Who Assists the State Shen Wenjing was made Inspector of Eastern Qing.
translations.idiomatic: [24] On the xinmao day Eastern Qing was established from Qing Province, and General Who Assists the State Shen Wenjing was appointed Inspector of Eastern Qing.

sentences.zh: [25]丁酉，安南將軍、江州刺史王景文進號鎮南將軍。

translations.literal: [25] On dingyou, General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was advanced in rank to General Who Guards the South.
translations.idiomatic: [25] On the dingyou day General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was promoted to General Who Guards the South.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，以驃騎長史張悅為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingchen day, Chief Clerk of the Agile Cavalry Zhang Yue was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingchen day Chief Clerk of the Agile Cavalry Zhang Yue was appointed Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔曰：「夫愆有小大，憲隨寬猛，故五刑殊用，三典異施。

translations.literal: On wuchen, an edict said: "Offenses have small and great; punishment follows lenience or severity—thus the five punishments are applied differently and the three canons are enacted variously.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day an edict declared: "Crimes vary in gravity, and the law must vary between lenience and severity—hence the five punishments are applied differently and the three canons enforced in different ways.

sentences.zh: 而降辟次網，便暨鉗撻，求之法科，差品滋遠。

translations.literal: Yet when death penalty and clemency follow the secondary net, one immediately reaches clogs and beatings; seeking it in the legal statutes, the grades grow ever more distant.
translations.idiomatic: Yet under secondary statutes one soon sinks to shackles and flogging; measured against the written code, the gradations have grown far too coarse.

sentences.zh: 朕務存欽卹，每有矜貸。

translations.literal: I am devoted to reverent compassion, and often grant clemency.
translations.idiomatic: I have sought to govern with reverent compassion and have often granted clemency.

sentences.zh: 尋劫制科罪，[26]輕重同之大辟，即事原情，未為詳衷。

translations.literal: Examining the statutes on robbery, [26] light and heavy alike receive the great execution—in judging the matter according to circumstance, this is not a detailed and centered approach.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the robbery statutes, [26] light and grave offenses alike receive capital punishment; judged case by case, this is neither precise nor fair.

sentences.zh: 自今凡竊執官仗，拒戰邏司，或攻剽亭寺，及害吏民者，凡此諸條，悉依舊制。

translations.literal: From now on, all who steal or seize official weapons, resist battle at the patrol office, or raid post stations and monasteries, and harm officials and commoners—in all such articles, follow entirely the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: From this day forward, all who steal official weapons, resist arrest, raid courier stations and temples, or harm officials and commoners—in every such case the old regulations shall apply.

sentences.zh: 五人以下相逼奪者，可特賜黥刖，投畀四遠，仍用代殺，方古為優，全命長戶，施同造物。

translations.literal: For those who under five persons mutually coerced seizure, they may be specially granted tattooing and amputation, cast into the four remote regions, and still employ substitution for execution—compared with antiquity this is superior, preserving life and lengthening households, bestowing like the Creator.
translations.idiomatic: For groups of fewer than five who jointly robbed by force, special tattooing and amputation may be imposed and the offenders exiled to the remotest regions, still using commutation for execution—more merciful than antiquity, preserving life and household, a grace like that of Heaven itself.

sentences.zh: 庶簡惠之化，有孚羣萌，好生之德，無漏幽品。

translations.literal: May the transformation of simplicity and grace win trust among the myriad people; the virtue of cherishing life let no hidden ranks be missed.
translations.idiomatic: May the rule of simplicity and mercy win the people's trust, and the virtue of cherishing life reach even those hidden from sight.

sentences.zh: 」庚午，曲赦揚、南徐、兗、豫四州。

translations.literal: " On gengwu, a partial amnesty was granted to Yang, Southern Xu, Yan, and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: " On the gengwu day a partial amnesty was extended to Yang, Southern Xu, Yan, and Yu provinces.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day guiyou—there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, guiyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 發諸州兵北討。

translations.literal: Troops were dispatched from the various provinces for the northern punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were mobilized from the provinces for the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 南康、建安、安成、宣城四郡，昔不同南逆，並不在徵發之例。

translations.literal: The four commanderies Nankang, Jian'an, Ancheng, and Xuancheng had in the past not joined the southern rebellion and were all excluded from the conscription quota.
translations.idiomatic: The four commanderies of Nankang, Jian'an, Ancheng, and Xuancheng had never joined the southern rebellion and were all exempt from the levy.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，割揚州之義興郡屬南徐州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Yixing commandery in Yang was detached and placed under Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Yixing commandery was detached from Yang and placed under Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸亥，車駕躬耕藉田。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, guihai day—the imperial carriage personally plowed the ceremonial field.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the guihai day of the first month of spring, the emperor personally plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，賜力田爵一級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire; merit farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and diligent farmers received one step in rank.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，分豫州、揚州立南豫州，以太尉廬江王褘為車騎將軍，開府儀同三司、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, bingshen day—Yu and Yang were divided to establish Southern Yu; Grand Marshal Prince Hui of Lujiang was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with Staff equal to Three Divisions and Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingshen day Southern Yu was established from Yu and Yang, and Grand Marshal Prince Hui of Lujiang was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry with protocol equal to a three-division office and Inspector of Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，於南豫州立南義陽郡。

translations.literal: Third month, yimao day—Southern Yiyang commandery was established within Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yimao day Southern Yiyang commandery was established within Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車駕幸中堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the imperial carriage visited the Central Hall to hear legal cases.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day the emperor visited the Central Hall to hear cases.

sentences.zh: 己巳，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jisi, the King of Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the King of Henan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，割雍州隨郡屬郢州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinwei day—Sui commandery in Yong was detached and placed under Ying.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinwei day Sui commandery was detached from Yong and placed under Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，割豫州義陽郡屬郢州，郢州西陽郡屬豫州。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Yiyang commandery in Yu was detached and placed under Ying; Xiyang commandery in Ying was placed under Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Yiyang commandery was transferred from Yu to Ying, and Xiyang commandery from Ying to Yu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以寧朔將軍崔公烈為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi, General Who Pacifies the North Cui Gonglie was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day General Who Pacifies the North Cui Gonglie was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，新除給事黃門侍郎杜幼文為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuxu, newly appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate in the Palace Secretariat Du Youwen was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day newly appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate in the Palace Secretariat Du Youwen was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，立晉平王休祐子宣曜為南平王。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinwei day, Xuanyao, son of Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, was established as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinwei day Xuanyao, son of Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: [27]壬申，以安西將軍、郢州刺史蔡興宗為鎮東將軍。

translations.literal: [27] On renshen, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was made General Who Guards the East.
translations.idiomatic: [27] On the renshen day General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was appointed General Who Guards the East.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以左衞將軍沈攸之為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: On guiyou, General of the Left Guard Shen Youzhi was made Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day General of the Left Guard Shen Youzhi was appointed Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 以軍興已來，百官斷俸，並給生食。

translations.literal: Since military campaigns had begun, all officials' salaries were cut off, and raw food was supplied instead.
translations.idiomatic: Since the outbreak of war, official salaries had been suspended and officials were given uncooked provisions instead.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，車騎將軍、南豫州刺史廬江王褘免官爵。

translations.literal: On dingchou, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu Prince Hui of Lujiang was stripped of office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu Prince Hui of Lujiang was deprived of his posts and titles.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以左將軍、行湘州刺史巴陵王休若為征南將軍、湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, General of the Left and Acting Inspector of Xiang Prince Xiuofan of Baling was made General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day General of the Left and Acting Inspector of Xiang Prince Xiuofan of Baling was appointed General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 壬午，罷南豫州。

translations.literal: On renwu, Southern Yu was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Southern Yu Province was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以新除給事黃門侍郎劉亮為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingxu, newly appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate in the Palace Secretariat Liu Liang was made Inspector of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day newly appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate in the Palace Secretariat Liu Liang was appointed Inspector of Yi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，以輔國將軍王亮為徐州刺史，東莞太守陳伯紹為交州刺史。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiyou day, General Who Assists the State Wang Liang was made Inspector of Xu; Administrator of Dongguan Chen Bozhao was made Inspector of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiyou day General Who Assists the State Wang Liang was appointed Inspector of Xu, and Administrator of Dongguan Chen Bozhao was made Inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以山陽太守李靈謙為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Administrator of Shanyang Li Lingqian was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Administrator of Shanyang Li Lingqian was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，改輔國將軍為輔師將軍。

translations.literal: On renxu, the title General Who Assists the State was changed to General Who Assists the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day the title General Who Assists the State was redesignated General Who Assists the Army.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，以右將軍行豫州刺史劉勔為平西將軍、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jichou day, General of the Right and Acting Inspector of Yu Liu Mian was made General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jichou day General of the Right and Acting Inspector of Yu Liu Mian was appointed General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以海陵太守劉崇智為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen, Administrator of Hailing Liu Chongzhi was made Inspector of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Administrator of Hailing Liu Chongzhi was appointed Inspector of Ji.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，立長沙王纂子延之為始平王。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiayin day, Yanzhi, son of Prince Zuan of Changsha, was established as Prince of Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiayin day Yanzhi, son of Prince Zuan of Changsha, was enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.

sentences.zh: 戊午，中領軍王琨遷職。

translations.literal: On wuwu, General of the Garrison Wang Kun changed posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day General of the Garrison Wang Kun was transferred from office.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔曰：「夫箕、潁之操，振古所貴，沖素之風，哲王攸重。

translations.literal: On jiwei, an edict said: "The integrity of Ji and Ying has been prized since antiquity; the pure and plain style is what sage kings have always held weighty.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day an edict declared: "The integrity of the hermits of Ji and Ying has been honored through the ages; the unadorned way of life is what wise rulers have always esteemed.

sentences.zh: 朕屬橫流之會，接難晦之辰，龕暴剪亂，日不暇給。

translations.literal: I have fallen in an age of crosscurrents and received the throne in troubled times; I have contained violence and cut off disorder, with not a day to spare.
translations.idiomatic: I came to the throne in an age of turmoil and inherited rule in dark and difficult days; though I have pacified the violent and suppressed rebellion, I have scarcely had a moment to rest.

sentences.zh: 今雖關、隴猶靄，區縣澄氛，偃武修文，於是乎在。

translations.literal: Now though Guan and Long still lie in haze, districts and counties are clearing the air; to lay down arms and cultivate culture—this is where we now stand.
translations.idiomatic: Though Guan and Long still remain unsettled, local districts are beginning to calm; the time to sheathe weapons and foster culture is now at hand.

sentences.zh: 思崇廉耻，用靜馳薄，固已物色載懷，寢興竚歎。

translations.literal: I mean to exalt integrity and shame, and thereby still impetuous license; seeking out men has long filled my heart, and waking and sleeping I stand and sigh.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to promote a sense of honor and shame and thereby restrain reckless indulgence; I have long kept this search in mind, rising and sleeping with sighs of concern.

sentences.zh: 其有貞栖隱約，息事衡樊，[28]鑿坏遺榮，負釣辭聘，志恬江海，行高塵俗者，在所精加搜括，時以名聞。

translations.literal: Those who steadfastly dwell in obscurity, rest in their homesteads, [28] break their walls and leave glory behind, fish by the river and decline office, whose hearts are content in rivers and seas and whose conduct rises above vulgar custom—in every place they are to be carefully sought out and brought to notice in due season.
translations.idiomatic: Those who live in steadfast seclusion, withdraw to quiet homesteads, [28] break down their doors and renounce rank, fish by the waterside and refuse summons, whose hearts find peace in rivers and seas and whose conduct towers above the vulgar—in every region they shall be diligently sought out and promptly brought to fame.

sentences.zh: 將賁園矜德，茂昭厥禮。

translations.literal: We shall adorn their gardens and honor their virtue, richly displaying the rites due them.
translations.idiomatic: We shall grace their estates and honor their virtue, making their due rites splendidly manifest.

sentences.zh: 羣司各舉所知，以時授爵。

translations.literal: Each office shall recommend those it knows, and titles shall be granted in due season.
translations.idiomatic: Every department shall recommend men of its acquaintance, and enfeoffments shall be conferred at the proper time.

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，以新除平西將軍、豫州刺史劉勔為中領軍。

translations.literal: " On yichou, newly appointed General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu Liu Mian was made General of the Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: " On the yichou day newly appointed General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu Liu Mian was appointed General of the Garrison.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingmao day, first day of the month—there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, dingmao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，索虜遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingwei day, the northern barbarians sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dingwei day, the northern barbarians sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊子，驃騎大將軍、荊州刺史晉平王休祐以本號為南徐州刺史，征南將軍、湘州刺史巴陵王休若為征西將軍、荊州刺史，輔師將軍孟次陽為兗州刺史，[29]義陽太守呂安國為司州刺史。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, wuzi day, Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jing, was made Inspector of Southern Xu under his original title; Prince Xiuofan of Baling, General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Xiang, was made General Who Campaigns West and Inspector of Jing; General Who Assists the Army Meng Ciyang was made Inspector of Yan; [29] Administrator of Yiyang Lu Anguo was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the wuzi day Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jing, was appointed Inspector of Southern Xu while retaining his original rank; Prince Xiuofan of Baling, General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Xiang, was made General Who Campaigns West and Inspector of Jing; General Who Assists the Army Meng Ciyang was appointed Inspector of Yan; [29] and Administrator of Yiyang Lu Anguo was made Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，司徒建安王休仁解揚州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuxu day, Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an relinquished the post of Inspector of Yang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuxu day Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an stepped down as Inspector of Yang.

sentences.zh: 己未，以征北大將軍、南徐州刺史桂陽王休範為中書監、中軍將軍、揚州刺史，[30]吳興太守建平王景素為湘州刺史，輔師將軍建安王世子伯融為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, General of the Center Army, and Inspector of Yang; [30] Administrator of Wuxing Prince Jingsu of Jianping was made Inspector of Xiang; General Who Assists the Army Boyong, heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Grand General Who Campaigns North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, General of the Center Army, and Inspector of Yang; [30] Administrator of Wuxing Prince Jingsu of Jianping was made Inspector of Xiang; and Boyong, heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an and General Who Assists the Army, was appointed Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: [31]庚申，分荊、益州五郡置三巴校尉。

translations.literal: [31] On gengshen, five commanderies of Jing and Yi were detached to establish the Commandant of Sanba.
translations.idiomatic: [31] On the gengshen day five commanderies from Jing and Yi were split off to establish the post of Commandant of Sanba.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月乙亥，初制間二年一祭南郊，間一年一祭明堂。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, yihai day—the first regulation was set that the Southern Suburb should be sacrificed to every other year and the Bright Hall every year.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the yihai day of the first month of spring, a new rule was established: sacrifice at the Southern Suburb every second year and at the Bright Hall every year.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，司徒建安王休仁為太尉，領司徒。

translations.literal: Second month, renyin day, Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was made Grand Marshal and continued as Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renyin day Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was appointed Grand Marshal while retaining the post of Minister.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，皇太子納妃。

translations.literal: On guichou, the Crown Prince took a consort.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day the Crown Prince received his bride.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiayin, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 巧注從軍，不在赦例。

translations.literal: Those whose registration had been falsified for military service were excluded from the amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Men entered for service through fraudulent annotation were not included in the amnesty.

sentences.zh: 班賜各有差。

translations.literal: Distributed gifts were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Bounty was distributed in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，中護軍劉襲卒。

translations.literal: Third month, yihai day, General Who Protects the Army Liu Xi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yihai day General Who Protects the Army Liu Xi died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以太子詹事張永為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhang Yong was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhang Yong was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，立第六皇子燮為晉熙王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guihai day, the sixth prince, Xie, was established as Prince of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the guihai day the sixth prince, Xie, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，以前軍將軍陳胤宗為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingchou day, former General of the Van Chen Yinzong was made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingchou day former General of the Van Chen Yinzong was appointed Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以冠軍將軍吐谷渾拾虔為平西將軍。

translations.literal: On dinghai, General Who Conquers the Champions Tuyuhun Shipian was made General Who Levels the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day General Who Conquers the Champions Tuyuhun Shipian was appointed General Who Levels the West.

sentences.zh: 戊子，奉朝請孔玉為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Court Gentleman-for-the-Duration Kong Yu was made Inspector of Ning.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Court Gentleman-for-the-Duration Kong Yu was appointed Inspector of Ning.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，以第五皇子智井繼東平沖王休倩。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jihai day, the fifth prince, Zhijing, succeeded Chong Prince Xiuxian of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jihai day the fifth prince, Zhijing, succeeded to the line of Chong Prince Xiuxian of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以侍中劉韞為撫軍將軍、雍州刺史，前將軍、郢州刺史沈攸之進號鎮軍將軍，揚州刺史桂陽王休範為征南大將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun was made General Who Comforts the Army and Inspector of Yong; General of the Van and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was advanced in rank to General Who Pacifies the Army; Inspector of Yang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Grand General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun was appointed General Who Comforts the Army and Inspector of Yong; General of the Van and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Pacifies the Army; and Inspector of Yang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Grand General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以鎮南將軍、江州刺史王景文為尚書左僕射、揚州刺史，尚書僕射袁粲為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On guimao, General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yang; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yang, and Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 己未，改臨賀郡為臨慶郡，追改東平王休倩為臨慶沖王。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Linhe commandery was changed to Linqing commandery, and Dongping Prince Xiuxian was posthumously redesignated Chong Prince of Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Linhe commandery was renamed Linqing commandery, and Prince Xiuxian of Dongping was posthumously retitled Chong Prince of Linqing.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，第五皇子智井薨。

translations.literal: Seventh month, bingxu day, the fifth prince, Zhijing, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the bingxu day the fifth prince, Zhijing, died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，中領軍劉勔加平北將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yichou day, General of the Garrison Liu Mian was given the additional rank General Who Levels the North.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yichou day General of the Garrison Liu Mian was also made General Who Levels the North.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，立總明觀，徵學士以充之。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Zongming Hall was established, and scholars were summoned to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day the Zongming Hall was founded and scholars were recruited to staff it.

sentences.zh: 置東觀祭酒。

translations.literal: The Director of the Eastern Pavilion was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Director of the Eastern Pavilion was appointed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以第八皇子智渙繼臨慶沖王休倩。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the eighth prince, Zhihuan, succeeded Chong Prince Xiuxian of Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day the eighth prince, Zhihuan, succeeded to the line of Chong Prince Xiuxian of Linqing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，立第九皇子贊為武陵王。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, xinmao day, the ninth prince, Zan, was established as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinmao day the ninth prince, Zan, was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以前右軍馬詵為北雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On yisi, former General of the Right Army Ma Shen was made Inspector of Northern Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day former General of the Right Army Ma Shen was appointed Inspector of Northern Yong.

sentences.zh: 己酉，車駕幸東堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the imperial carriage visited the Eastern Hall to hear legal cases.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day the emperor visited the Eastern Hall to hear cases.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jisi day, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jisi day the state of Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，以邊難未息，制父母陷異域，悉使婚宦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guisi day, because border troubles had not yet ceased, it was decreed that wherever parents were trapped in foreign lands, all should marry and take office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guisi day, because frontier warfare had not yet ended, an edict ordered that wherever parents remained captive in enemy territory, their children should marry and accept official posts.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以始興郡為宋安郡。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Shixing commandery was changed to Song'an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Shixing commandery was renamed Song'an commandery.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，護軍將軍張永遷職。

translations.literal: On bingchen, General Who Protects the Army Zhang Yong changed posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day General Who Protects the Army Zhang Yong was transferred from office.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，索虜遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Third month, xinyou day, the northern barbarians sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day the northern barbarians sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，芮芮國遣使奉獻。

translations.literal: On renxu, the state of Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day the state of Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，減天下死罪一等，凡敕繫悉遣之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinchou day, death sentences throughout the empire were reduced one grade, and all held under edict were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinchou day capital punishment was commuted one degree throughout the realm, and everyone detained by imperial order was set free.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，於南兗州置新平郡。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Xinping commandery was established within Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Xinping commandery was created within Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，金紫光祿大夫張永領護軍。

translations.literal: On guichou, Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Zhang Yong concurrently held the post of General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Zhang Yong was additionally placed in charge as General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，司徒建安王休仁有罪，自殺。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuwu day, Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, guilty of a crime, killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuwu day Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, found guilty of an offense, took his own life.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以寧朔長史孫超之為廣州刺史，尚書左僕射、揚州刺史王景文以刺史領中書監。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Chief Clerk of the General Who Pacifies the North Sun Chaozhi was made Inspector of Guang; Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen held the post of Supervisor of the Masters of Writing concurrently with his inspectorship.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Chief Clerk of the General Who Pacifies the North Sun Chaozhi was appointed Inspector of Guang; Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen served concurrently as Supervisor of the Masters of Writing while remaining inspector.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以尚書右僕射袁粲為尚書令，新除吏部尚書褚淵為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was made Director of the Masters of Writing; newly appointed Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing, and newly appointed Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: [32]辛未，監吳郡王僧虔行湘州刺史。

translations.literal: [32] On xinwei, Wang Sengqian of Wu commandery supervised as Acting Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: [32] On the xinwei day Wang Sengqian of Wu commandery was placed in supervisory charge as Acting Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，追免晉平王休祐為庶人。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Prince Xiuyou of Jinping was posthumously stripped to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Prince Xiuyou of Jinping was retroactively degraded to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，以征南大將軍、江州刺史桂陽王休範為驃騎大將軍、南徐州刺史，征北大將軍巴陵王休若為車騎大將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingyou day, Grand General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Southern Xu; Grand General Who Campaigns North Prince Xiuofan of Baling was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingyou day Grand General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Southern Xu, and Grand General Who Campaigns North Prince Xiuofan of Baling was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the state of Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the state of Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，罷散騎奏舉郎。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingsi day, the Scattered Cavalry Presenter of Memorials Attendant was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingsi day the post of Scattered Cavalry Presenter of Memorials Attendant was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，新除車騎大將軍、江州刺史巴陵王休若薨，桂陽王休範以新除驃騎大將軍，還為江州。

translations.literal: On yichou, newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiuofan of Baling died; Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, newly appointed General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast, returned to Jiang as inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiuofan of Baling died; Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, having just been made General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast, returned to serve as inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以第三皇子準為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the third prince, Zhun, was made General Who Comforts the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day the third prince, Zhun, was appointed General Who Comforts the Army.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以太子詹事劉秉為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Liu Bing was made Inspector of Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Liu Bing was appointed Inspector of Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以寧朔將軍沈懷明為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, General Who Pacifies the North Shen Huaiming was made Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day General Who Pacifies the North Shen Huaiming was appointed Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，於冀州置西海郡。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Xihai commandery was established within Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Xihai commandery was created within Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，第八皇子躋繼江夏文獻王義恭。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuzi day, the eighth prince, Ji, succeeded Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, posthumous title Wen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuzi day the eighth prince, Ji, succeeded to the line of Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, posthumous title Wen.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以疾愈大赦天下。

translations.literal: On gengyin, because illness had healed, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, upon recovery from illness, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 冀州刺史劉崇智加青州刺史。

translations.literal: Inspector of Ji Liu Chongzhi was given the additional post of Inspector of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Ji Liu Chongzhi was also made Inspector of Qing.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，立第三皇子準為安成王。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the third prince, Zhun, was established as Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day the third prince, Zhun, was enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以越騎校尉周寧民為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinwei day, Colonel of Fast Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinwei day Colonel of Fast Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was appointed Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊午，[33]百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, wuwu day, [33] the state of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the wuwu day, [33] the state of Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，分豫州、南兗州立南豫州，以歷陽太守王玄載為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dingyou day, Yu and Southern Yan were divided to establish Southern Yu; Administrator of Liyang Wang Xuanzai was made Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingyou day Southern Yu was established from Yu and Southern Yan, and Administrator of Liyang Wang Xuanzai was appointed its inspector.

sentences.zh: 泰豫元年春正月甲寅朔，上有疾不朝會。

translations.literal: First year of Taizong, spring, first month, jiayin day, first day of the month—the emperor was ill and did not hold court audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taizong, on the first day of the first month of spring, jiayin, the emperor was ill and did not attend court.

sentences.zh: 以疾患未痊，故改元。

translations.literal: Because illness had not yet healed, the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Because his illness had not yet fully recovered, the reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 賜孤老貧疾粟帛各有差。

translations.literal: Grain and silk were bestowed upon the orphaned, aged, poor, and sick in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Grain and cloth were granted to orphans, the elderly, the poor, and the sick in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 戊午，皇太子會萬國於東宮，并受貢計。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Crown Prince convened the myriad states at the Eastern Palace and also received tribute accounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day the Crown Prince received the tribute-bearing states at the Eastern Palace and took in their tribute registers.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，以給事黃門侍郎王瞻為司州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, xinchou day, Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate in the Palace Secretariat Wang Zhan was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinchou day Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate in the Palace Secretariat Wang Zhan was appointed Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑朔，林邑國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Third month, guichou day, first day of the month—the state of Linyi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, guichou, the state of Linyi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己未，中書監、揚州刺史王景文卒。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，以撫軍司馬蔡那為益州刺史。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinmao day, Chief Clerk of the General Who Comforts the Army Cai Na was made Inspector of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinmao day Chief Clerk of the General Who Comforts the Army Cai Na was appointed Inspector of Yi.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以右衞將軍張興世為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On guisi, General of the Left Guard Zhang Xingshi was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day General of the Left Guard Zhang Xingshi was appointed Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: [34]己亥，上大漸。

translations.literal: [34] On jihai, the emperor fell gravely ill.
translations.idiomatic: [34] On the jihai day the emperor grew deathly ill.

sentences.zh: 驃騎大將軍、江州刺史桂陽王休範進位司空，尚書右僕射褚淵為護軍將軍，中領軍劉勔加尚書右僕射，鎮東將軍蔡興宗為征西將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史，鎮軍將軍、郢州刺史沈攸之進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jiang, was advanced to Minister of Works; Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Chu Yuan was made General Who Protects the Army; General of the Garrison Liu Mian was given the additional post of Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; General Who Guards the East Cai Xingzong was made General Who Campaigns West with Staff equal to Three Divisions and Inspector of Jing; General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was advanced in rank to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jiang, was promoted to Minister of Works; Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Chu Yuan was appointed General Who Protects the Army; General of the Garrison Liu Mian was also made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; General Who Guards the East Cai Xingzong was appointed General Who Campaigns West with protocol equal to a three-division office and Inspector of Jing; and General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕自臨御億兆，仍屬戎寇，雖每存弘化，而惠弗覃遠，軍國凋弊，刑訟未息。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Since I began to rule the myriad people, we have still been afflicted by martial invaders; though I have always cherished broad transformation, grace has not spread to the distance; army and state are depleted, and litigation has not ceased.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Since I ascended the throne to govern the myriad people, we have still been harried by enemy armies; though I have constantly sought broad reform, my kindness has not reached far enough; the army and state are exhausted, and lawsuits have not yet ended.

sentences.zh: 今大漸維危，載深矜歎。

translations.literal: Now as death approaches and peril is grave, my sighs of compassion run deep.
translations.idiomatic: Now, as my end draws near and danger is acute, my compassionate grief is profound.

sentences.zh: 可緩徭優調，去繁就約。

translations.literal: Corvée may be eased and assessments lightened; discard complexity and pursue simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée labor should be relaxed and tax levies eased; cast off what is burdensome and keep what is essential.

sentences.zh: 因改之宜，詳有簡衷。

translations.literal: In accordance with the fit of the change, examine and select with care what is central.
translations.idiomatic: In keeping with the needs of this change of reign, review matters carefully and choose what is truly essential.

sentences.zh: 務以愛民為先，以宣朕遺意。

translations.literal: Make loving the people the first priority, to proclaim my testamentary intent.
translations.idiomatic: Put the welfare of the people first, and thereby give expression to my final wishes.

sentences.zh: 」袁粲、褚淵、劉勔、蔡興宗、沈攸之同被顧命。

translations.literal: 」Yuan Can, Chu Yuan, Liu Yan, Cai Xingzong, and Shen Youzhi were all entrusted with the dying charge.
translations.idiomatic: 」Yuan Can, Chu Yuan, Liu Yan, Cai Xingzong, and Shen Youzhi were all entrusted with the testamentary charge.

sentences.zh: 是日，上崩于景福殿，時年三十四。

translations.literal: That same day, the emperor passed away in the Hall of Blessed Felicity, aged thirty-four.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the emperor died in the Hall of Blessed Felicity, at the age of thirty-four.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，葬臨沂縣莫府山高寧陵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the wuyin day, [he] was buried at Gaoning Mausoleum on Mount Mofu in Linyi county.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuyin day, he was interred at Gaoning Mausoleum on Mount Mofu in Linyi county.

sentences.zh: 帝少而和令，風姿端雅。

translations.literal: The emperor from youth was harmonious and gentle, with bearing dignified and refined.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood the emperor was mild and gracious, with a stately and elegant bearing.

sentences.zh: 早失所生，養於太后宮內。

translations.literal: He lost his birth mother early and was reared within the Empress Dowager's palace.
translations.idiomatic: His birth mother died when he was young, and he was raised in the Empress Dowager's inner palace.

sentences.zh: 大明世，諸弟多被猜忌，唯上見親，常侍路太后醫藥。

translations.literal: In the Daming reign, many of the younger princes were subject to suspicion, but only the emperor was treated as close and familiar, constantly attending Empress Dowager Lu with medicine and care.
translations.idiomatic: During the Daming era many of his younger brothers fell under suspicion, yet the emperor alone remained in favor and regularly attended Empress Dowager Lu in her illness.

sentences.zh: 好讀書，愛文義，在藩時，撰江左以來文章志，又續衞瓘所注論語二卷，行於世。

translations.literal: He loved reading and cherished literary meaning; while in his princely fief he compiled a catalogue of writings since the Jiangzuo period, and also continued Wei Guan's two-fascicle commentary on the Analects, which circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He loved books and literary pursuits; while still a prince he compiled a catalogue of writings since the Jiangzuo period and continued Wei Guan's two-fascicle commentary on the Analects, both of which circulated widely.

sentences.zh: 及即大位，四方反叛，以寬仁待物，諸軍帥有父兄子弟同逆者，並授以禁兵，委任不易，故眾為之用，莫不盡力。

translations.literal: When he ascended the throne, rebellion broke out on all sides; he treated people with broad kindness, and where army commanders had fathers, elder brothers, sons, or younger brothers who had joined the rebellion, he still entrusted them with the palace guard, keeping his appointments unchanged; therefore the masses served him and none failed to exert their utmost.
translations.idiomatic: After he took the throne rebellions erupted everywhere, yet he treated people with generous forbearance; even commanders whose fathers, brothers, or sons had joined the rebels were still given command of the palace guard without change of appointment, and so his armies served him wholeheartedly.

sentences.zh: 平定天下，逆黨多被全，其有才能者，並見授用，有如舊臣。

translations.literal: When the realm was pacified, many of the rebel faction were spared; those with ability were all appointed to office, just like former ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Once the realm was pacified, many rebels were spared, and men of talent were appointed to office as if they had long served the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 才學之士，多蒙引進，參侍文籍，應對左右。

translations.literal: Men of talent and learning were often brought forward, attending on literary works and answering at the emperor's side.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars and men of letters were frequently promoted to attend on literary matters and converse at the emperor's side.

sentences.zh: 於華林園含芳堂講周易，[35]常自臨聽。

translations.literal: At the Hall of Fragrant Blossoms in the Hualin Garden he lectured on the Book of Changes, [35] and the emperor often attended in person to listen.
translations.idiomatic: Lectures on the Book of Changes were held at the Hall of Fragrant Blossoms in the Hualin Garden, [35] and the emperor often listened in person.

sentences.zh: 末年好鬼神，多忌諱，言語文書，有禍敗凶喪及疑似之言應回避者，數百千品，有犯必加罪戮。

translations.literal: In his later years he favored spirits and ghosts and had many taboos; in speech and documents there were hundreds and thousands of categories of words concerning disaster, defeat, mourning, death, and suspicious expressions that had to be avoided, and any violation was punished by execution.
translations.idiomatic: In his final years he grew obsessed with spirits and taboos; speech and official writing had to avoid hundreds of words associated with disaster, defeat, mourning, and death, and offenders were put to death.

sentences.zh: 改「騧」為馬邊瓜，[36]亦以「騧」字似「禍」字故也。

translations.literal: He changed the character gua (for piebald horse) to 「horse beside melon」, [36] also because the character gua resembles the character for calamity.
translations.idiomatic: He replaced the taboo character gua (written for piebald horse) with 「horse beside melon」, [36] because gua resembled the character for calamity.

sentences.zh: 以南苑借張永，云「且給三百年，期訖更啟」。

translations.literal: He lent the Southern Park to Zhang Yong, saying, 「It is only granted for three hundred years; when the term ends, apply again.」
translations.idiomatic: He lent the Southern Park to Zhang Yong, saying, 「This grant is only for three hundred years; when the term expires, you must apply again.」

sentences.zh: 其事類皆如此。

translations.literal: Matters of this sort were all like this.
translations.idiomatic: His dealings were all of this sort.

sentences.zh: 宣陽門，民間謂之白門，上以白門之名不祥，甚諱之。

translations.literal: The Xuanyang Gate was popularly called the White Gate; the emperor considered the name White Gate inauspicious and greatly tabooed it.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanyang Gate was commonly called the White Gate; the emperor regarded the name as ill-omened and strictly forbade it.

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞江謐嘗誤犯，上變色曰：「白汝家門！

translations.literal: Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Mi once accidentally violated the taboo; the emperor changed color and said: 「White your family gate!
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Mi once accidentally used the forbidden word; the emperor flushed with anger and said: 「May your family gate be whitened!

sentences.zh: 」謐稽顙謝，久之方釋。

translations.literal: 」Mi prostrated himself and apologized; only after a long while was he released.
translations.idiomatic: 」Mi kowtowed in apology and was not dismissed until some time had passed.

sentences.zh: 太后停屍漆牀先出東宮，上嘗幸宮，見之怒甚，免中庶子官，職局以之坐者數十人。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager's corpse was placed on a lacquered couch and taken out of the Eastern Palace first; the emperor once visited the palace, saw it, and was furious; he dismissed the Palace Attendant, and several dozen officials in the relevant office were punished for it.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager's body was placed on a lacquered couch and removed from the Eastern Palace ahead of the proper rites; when the emperor visited the palace and saw this he was enraged, dismissed the Palace Attendant, and punished several dozen officials in the responsible office.

sentences.zh: [37]內外常慮犯觸，人不自保。

translations.literal: [37] Inside and outside the court people constantly feared giving offense, and no one could feel secure.
translations.idiomatic: [37] At court and beyond, people lived in constant fear of giving offense and could not feel safe.

sentences.zh: 宮內禁忌尤甚，移牀治壁，必先祭土神，使文士為文詞祝策，如大祭饗。

translations.literal: Taboos within the palace were especially severe; when moving beds or repairing walls, one had first to sacrifice to the Earth Spirit, have literary men compose ritual texts and prayer slips, as at a great sacrificial feast.
translations.idiomatic: Palace taboos were especially strict: moving beds or repairing walls required sacrifice to the Earth Spirit and ritual compositions by literary men, as at a major state sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 泰始、泰豫之際，更忍虐好殺，左右失旨忤意，往往有斮刳斷截者。

translations.literal: At the transition between Taishi and Taiyu, he became more cruel and fond of killing; attendants at his side who missed his intent or displeased him were often hacked, disemboweled, or cut apart.
translations.idiomatic: At the transition from Taishi to Taiyu he grew more brutal and bloodthirsty; attendants who missed his meaning or displeased him were often hacked apart, disemboweled, or mutilated.

sentences.zh: 時經略淮、泗，軍旅不息，荒弊積久，府藏空竭。

translations.literal: At that time campaigns were waged along the Huai and Si, armies never rested, desolation and ruin accumulated over long years, and the treasury was emptied.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigns along the Huai and Si kept the armies constantly in the field; after years of devastation the treasury was exhausted.

sentences.zh: 內外百官，並日料祿俸；

translations.literal: Officials inside and outside the court all received daily rations of salary and stipends;
translations.idiomatic: Officials throughout the court and provinces were paid their salaries and stipends by the day;

sentences.zh: [38]而上奢費過度，務為彫侈。

translations.literal: [38] yet the emperor was extravagant beyond measure and pursued carved and lavish display.
translations.idiomatic: [38] yet the emperor spent extravagantly and insisted on ornate luxury.

sentences.zh: 每所造制，必為正御三十副，御次、副又各三十，須一物輒造九十枚，天下騷然，民不堪命。

translations.literal: For every object he had made, there had to be thirty sets for the primary imperial use, and the secondary imperial and tertiary sets each thirty more as well; a single item required ninety pieces to be made, and the realm was in uproar— the people could not bear the burden.
translations.idiomatic: Every object he ordered was made in thirty sets for primary imperial use, thirty for secondary use, and thirty for tertiary use—ninety pieces for a single item—throwing the realm into turmoil and crushing the people.

sentences.zh: 其餘事迹，列見眾篇。

translations.literal: His remaining deeds are set out in detail in the various chapters.
translations.idiomatic: His other deeds are recorded in detail elsewhere in the work.

sentences.zh: [39]親近讒慝，剪落皇枝，宋氏之業，自此衰矣。

translations.literal: [39] Those close to him slandered the wicked and pruned away the imperial branches; from this the house of Song declined.
translations.idiomatic: [39] Favorites spread slander and cut down the imperial clan; from that point the Song dynasty began to decline.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：聖人立法垂制，所以必稱先王，蓋由遺訓餘風，足以貽之來世也。

translations.literal: The historian says: The sage establishes law and transmits institutions; that is why he must invoke the former kings—it is because their surviving instructions and lingering influence are enough to bequeath to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: Sages establish laws and transmit institutions, and therefore invoke the former kings—their surviving instructions and enduring influence are enough to bequeath to posterity.

sentences.zh: 太祖負扆南面，實有君人之懿焉，經國之義雖弘，而隆家之道不足。

translations.literal: The Founding Emperor, leaning on the screen and facing south, truly had the excellence of one who rules men; though the principles of governing the state were broad, the way of exalting the family was insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: The Founding Emperor, seated facing south with the screen at his back, truly possessed the virtues of a ruler; though his statecraft was far-reaching, he did not sufficiently strengthen the royal house.

sentences.zh: 彭城王照不窺古，本無卓爾之資，[40]徒見昆弟之義，未識君臣之禮，冀以此家情，行之國道，主猜而猶犯，恩薄而未悟，致以呵訓之微行，遂成滅親之大禍。

translations.literal: Prince Zhao of Pengcheng did not look to antiquity and by nature lacked outstanding talent, [40] seeing only the righteousness among brothers and not recognizing the rites between ruler and minister; he hoped to apply this family sentiment to the way of the state—the ruler was suspicious yet he still overstepped, favor was thin yet he still did not understand, and a slight act of rebuke and reproof became the great calamity of destroying kin.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhao of Pengcheng did not study antiquity and lacked outstanding talent, [40] understanding only brotherly affection and not the rites between ruler and minister; he tried to govern the state by family sentiment—the suspicious sovereign was provoked, slender grace went unheeded, and a minor rebuke became the great catastrophe of kin destroyed.

sentences.zh: 開端樹隙，垂之後人。

translations.literal: He opened the breach and planted the rift, leaving it to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the breach and planted discord for those who came after.

sentences.zh: 雖天倫之重，義殊凡戚，而中人以下，情由恩變。

translations.literal: Although the weight of heavenly kinship differs in principle from ordinary affection, for those below the middling sort feeling follows favor.
translations.idiomatic: Though the bonds of kin are weightier in principle than ordinary affection, for men of middling character feeling follows favor.

sentences.zh: 至於易衣而出，分苦而食，與夫別宮異門，形疎事隔者，宜有降矣。

translations.literal: As for changing clothes to go out, sharing hardship in eating, and on the other hand separate palaces and different gates with form distant and affairs divided—there ought to be a descent.
translations.idiomatic: Between sharing clothes and food in hardship on the one hand and living in separate palaces behind different gates on the other, affection ought naturally to decline.

sentences.zh: 太宗因易隙之情，據已行之典，剪落洪枝，願不待慮。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong, relying on the sentiment opened by that rift, took the precedent already in practice and pruned away the great branches, without waiting for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong, exploiting the rift thus opened, followed precedent already in force and pruned the great branches of the clan without hesitation.

sentences.zh: 既而本根無庇，幼主孤立，神器以勢弱傾移，靈命隨樂推回改。

translations.literal: Thereafter the root had no shelter, the young sovereign stood alone, the imperial vessel shifted because power was weak, and the mandate changed with the tide of acclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the dynasty lost its foundation, the young emperor stood alone, the throne shifted as power weakened, and the mandate changed with the tide of popular acclaim.

sentences.zh: 斯蓋履霜有漸，堅冰自至，所從來遠也。

translations.literal: This is probably like treading on frost by degrees until solid ice comes of itself—the source lies far back.
translations.idiomatic: This is the gradual treading of frost until solid ice forms—the cause lies far in the past.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Textual collation notes

sentences.zh: 南徐州刺史永嘉王子仁為中軍將軍 各本並脫「南」字，據永嘉王子仁傳補。

translations.literal: Liu Ziren, Prince of Yongjia, Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, was made General of the Central Army: All editions alike omit the character 「Southern」; it is supplied according to the biography of Liu Ziren, Prince of Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: 「Liu Ziren, Prince of Yongjia, Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, was made General of the Central Army」: all editions omit 「Southern」; restored from the biography of Liu Ziren, Prince of Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 癸酉 各本並作「壬午」，據建康實錄改。

translations.literal: Guiyou day: In all editions this appears as 「renwu」; it is emended according to the Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: 「Guiyou day」: all editions read 「renwu」; emended per the Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚申朔，十三日壬申，十六日乙亥。

translations.literal: According to this, that month's gengshen was the first day; the thirteenth day was renshen, and the sixteenth day was yihai.
translations.idiomatic: That month's gengshen was the first day; the thirteenth was renshen and the sixteenth yihai.

sentences.zh: 宋書本紀此詔在十三日壬申後，十六日乙亥前，則作壬午誤，作癸酉是。

translations.literal: In the Basic Annals of the Book of Song this edict falls after the thirteenth day renshen and before the sixteenth day yihai; therefore reading it as renwu is wrong, and reading it as guiyou is correct.
translations.idiomatic: In the Book of Song Basic Annals this edict falls between renshen (the thirteenth) and yihai (the sixteenth); 「renwu」 is wrong and 「guiyou」 is correct.

sentences.zh: 詳悉條奏 「詳」各本並作「許」，據元龜二一三改。

translations.literal: Report the details item by item in memorial: In all editions 「detail」 appears as 「permit」; it is emended according to Yuan Gui 213.
translations.idiomatic: 「Report the details item by item in memorial」: all editions read 「permit」 for 「detail」; emended per Yuan Gui 213.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍劉勔前鋒西討 「西討」各本作「南討」，據南史改。

translations.literal: General Who Assists the State Liu Yan, vanguard, campaign west: In all editions 「campaign west」 appears as 「campaign south」; it is emended according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: 「Liu Yan, vanguard on the western campaign」: all editions read 「campaign south」 for 「campaign west」; emended per the Southern History.

sentences.zh: 按劉勔時攻壽陽，當云「西討」。

translations.literal: According to this, at that time Liu Yan was attacking Shouyang; it should read 「campaign west」.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan was then attacking Shouyang; the text should read 「campaign west」.

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍殷孝祖攻赭圻死之以輔國將軍沈攸之代為南討前鋒 「撫軍」下脫文十三字，據南史補。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the Army Yin Xiaozu attacked Zhihu and died; General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi replaced him as vanguard of the southern campaign: Below 「General Who Pacifies the Army」 thirteen characters are missing; they are supplied according to the Southern History.
translations.idiomatic: 「Yin Xiaozu attacked Zhihu and died, and Shen Youzhi replaced him as vanguard of the southern campaign」: thirteen characters are missing after 「General Who Pacifies the Army」; restored from the Southern History.

sentences.zh: 時殷孝祖為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: At that time Yin Xiaozu was General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Yin Xiaozu held the rank of General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 史事參沈攸之傳、殷孝祖傳。

translations.literal: For the historical events, see the biographies of Shen Youzhi and Yin Xiaozu.
translations.idiomatic: See the biographies of Shen Youzhi and Yin Xiaozu for the historical background.

sentences.zh: 葬崇憲皇太后於修寧陵 「修」各本並譌「攸」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Chongxian was buried at Xiuning Mausoleum: In all editions 「xiu」 is corrupted as 「you」; it is emended according to the Southern History and the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: 「Burial at Xiuning Mausoleum」: all editions corrupt 「xiu」 as 「you」; emended per the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 通鑑胡三省注曰：「修寧陵，在孝武陵東南。」

translations.literal: Hu Sanxing's commentary in the Comprehensive Mirror says: 「Xiuning Mausoleum lies southeast of Emperor Xiaowu's mausoleum.」
translations.idiomatic: Hu Sanxing's note in the Comprehensive Mirror: 「Xiuning Mausoleum lies southeast of Emperor Xiaowu's mausoleum.」

sentences.zh: 以建安王休仁世子伯融為豫州刺史 「豫州」建安王休仁傳作「南豫州」。

translations.literal: Bo Rong, heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, was made Inspector of Yuzhou: In the biography of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an 「Yuzhou」 appears as 「Southern Yuzhou」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Bo Rong was made Inspector of Yuzhou」: the biography of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an reads 「Southern Yuzhou」.

sentences.zh: 以吳郡太守顧覬之為湘州刺史 「覬」各本並作「顗」，據覬之傳改。

translations.literal: Gu Guanzhi, Administrator of Wu commandery, was made Inspector of Xiangzhou: In all editions 「guan」 appears as 「yi」; it is emended according to Gu Guanzhi's biography.
translations.idiomatic: 「Gu Guanzhi was made Inspector of Xiangzhou」: all editions read 「yi」 for 「guan」; emended per his biography.

sentences.zh: 曲赦揚南徐二州 各本並脫「南」字，據建康實錄補。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to Yang and Southern Xu provinces: All editions alike omit the character 「Southern」; it is supplied according to the Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: 「Partial amnesty for Yang and Southern Xu provinces」: all editions omit 「Southern」; restored from the Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 出獻納貢 「出」元龜一九八作「來」。

translations.literal: Present tribute for submission: In Yuan Gui 198 「present」 appears as 「come」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Present tribute for submission」: Yuan Gui 198 reads 「come」 for 「present」.

sentences.zh: 夫秉機詢政 「秉」各本並作「矢」，據元龜二一二改。

translations.literal: To hold the reins and inquire into government: In all editions 「hold」 appears as 「arrow」; it is emended according to Yuan Gui 212.
translations.idiomatic: 「To hold the reins and inquire into government」: all editions read 「arrow」 for 「hold」; emended per Yuan Gui 212.

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍劉靈遺為梁南秦二州刺史 「劉靈遺」各本並作「劉靈道」。

translations.literal: General Who Assists the State Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces: In all editions 「Liu Lingyi」 appears as 「Liu Lingdao」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin」: all editions read 「Liu Lingdao」 for 「Liu Lingyi」.

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「當作『劉靈遺』，鄧琬傳可證。
